02品牌BRAND

一縷煙，一陣風A thread of smoke, a breath of wind

芳巽堂是臺灣的手作線香品牌，手工研發、揉製，透過對香氣的喜好與鑽研，讓點香成為生活裡一段輕盈的儀式。FangXun is a Taiwanese handmade incense brand. We develop and roll every stick by hand, and through a love of scent and careful study, we make lighting incense a light ritual in daily life.

芳

芳自芬菲Fragrance that blooms by itself

取自香草、花木與臺灣風土植物。不因外界嘈雜而改變的本質，便是「芳自芬菲」。Herbs, flowers and Taiwan's native plants. Staying true however loud the world gets: that is 芳自芬菲, fragrance blooming on its own.

巽

巽下木生風Xun: wood, then wind

巽卦象徵木、風與入。香氣如風，輕盈無蹤，卻悄悄進入空間與身心的縫隙。In the I Ching, Xun means wood, wind and gentle entry. Scent moves like wind, weightless, slipping into rooms and the folds of the day.

03工藝CRAFT

手揉、陰乾、慢萃Hand-rolled, air-dried, slow-extracted

不添加人工定香劑與助燃劑，搭配天然植物黏粉，純手工揉製、自然陰乾。No artificial fixatives or accelerants. Natural plant binding powder, rolled by hand and dried in the open air.

以酊劑低溫萃取芳香分子，再與木粉合香。煙細、不熏眼、落灰乾淨。Aromatic molecules are extracted in tincture at low temperature, then blended into the wood powder. The smoke is fine and gentle on the eyes, and the ash is clean.
